# Contract: OpenAPI Documentation and Swagger UI

*Generated by spec-writer. Hand edits are overwritten on regeneration.*

## Prerequisites

These conditions describe the environment in which items in this
contract are exercised. Producing them is part of the feature's
deliverable, alongside the implementation itself — a contract whose
prerequisites are not yet satisfied is not failing, it is still being
built. Once the feature is delivered, any missing condition halts item
execution until it is restored.

**Runtime services:**
- a PostgreSQL 16 server is reachable at the `DATABASE_URL` provided by `.env.test`, and its role can create and drop databases (each item runs against its own isolated database)
- the `task-api` service built from this repository is available both as an in-process router and as a spawnable binary (`cargo run` or the compiled `task-api` executable) listening on a TCP port
- a Rust stable toolchain ≥ 1.100 with the `rustfmt` and `clippy` components is installed
- a headless browser with JavaScript enabled (Chromium class) can load pages from `http://127.0.0.1:<port>` and expose the network requests a page makes (UI items)

**Persistent state:**
- `migrated-db` — a PostgreSQL database exists on which every migration shipped so far has been applied exactly once with matching checksums; the `tasks` table exists and holds zero rows unless an item's `given` adds rows. Used by: every item in the `HTTP API` and `UI` sections.
- `seed-task` — `tasks` in `migrated-db` holds exactly one row, with a server-generated id and timestamps: title `Seed task`, description `Has a description`, status `todo`, priority `low`, due_date `2026-12-01`. Used by: API-OPERATIONS-04, API-CONFORMANCE-06, API-CONFORMANCE-09, API-CONFORMANCE-15, API-CONFORMANCE-16, API-CONFORMANCE-17.

**Static inputs:**
- `tests/fixtures/openapi-3.1-schema.json` — the official OpenAPI 3.1 JSON Schema, committed verbatim from `https://spec.openapis.org/oas/3.1/schema/2022-10-07` (its `$id` is that URL and its `$schema` is JSON Schema draft 2020-12). Used by: API-SPEC-03.

**Configuration:**
- `.env.test` at the repository root defines `DATABASE_URL` for the PostgreSQL 16 server above, and its variables are present in the environment of `cargo test`
- unless an item states otherwise: `HOST=127.0.0.1`, `PORT=<a free TCP port>`, `DATABASE_MAX_CONNECTIONS=10`, `DATABASE_ACQUIRE_TIMEOUT_SECS=5`, `DATABASE_URL` pointing to `migrated-db`, `ENABLE_TEST_ROUTES` unset
- `ENABLE_TEST_ROUTES=true` mounts the existing diagnostic route `GET /__test/slow?ms=<0..30000>[&hold_db=true]`, used only by API-SPEC-05 and API-CONFORMANCE-02; when the flag is unset or `false`, that path behaves as an unknown route
- `<base-url>` is `http://127.0.0.1:<PORT>` of the listening service; `<version>` is the `version` of `[package]` in `Cargo.toml`
- `{seed}` denotes the id of the `seed-task` row; `<random-uuid>` denotes a freshly generated lowercase hyphenated UUID v4 that is not the id of any row in `tasks`
- HTTP requests are sent without following redirects
- `spec` denotes the parsed JSON body of `GET /openapi.json` from the service under test
- a status is *documented* for an operation when it is a key of that operation's `responses` object in `spec`
- a property or schema *refers to* `X` when it is `{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/X"}` (sibling keywords such as `default`, `description` or `example` allowed), or an `allOf`/`oneOf`/`anyOf` whose single non-null member is that `$ref`
- a property *admits null* when its `type` is or contains `"null"`, or it has an `allOf`/`oneOf`/`anyOf` member `{"type":"null"}`; it *does not admit null* otherwise
- a value *validates against `X`* when JSON Schema draft 2020-12 validation of the value against `#/components/schemas/X`, with every `$ref` resolved inside `spec`, reports zero errors (`format` is treated as an annotation)
- an operation, media type or parameter *carries an example* when it has an `example`, a non-empty `examples`, or its schema has an `example`/non-empty `examples`
- the `tasks` table can be read directly with SQL (outside the service) so items can assert stored rows
- Build items may create a scratch copy of the repository (a temporary `git worktree` or a plain copy) and modify it without affecting the delivered tree; `.env.test` variables are exported when `cargo test` runs there

## Quality gates

Each gate must pass for the feature to be considered ready.

- **Format** — `cargo fmt --check` — every source file is already rustfmt-formatted; the command exits 0 with no diff.
- **Lint** — `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` — all targets (library, binary, tests) compile with zero clippy warnings.
- **Tests** — `cargo test` — every unit and integration test passes against isolated `#[sqlx::test]` databases on the PostgreSQL server named by `.env.test`.
- **Offline build** — `SQLX_OFFLINE=true cargo build` — the project compiles from the committed `.sqlx/` metadata without contacting a database.

## HTTP API

**Verification mode:** Send an HTTP request to the running service (in-process router or bound listener) without following redirects; assert response status, headers and body, check the stated facts on the parsed JSON body, and read the `tasks` table directly where stated.

### Serve Spec

**Common given:** the service is running against `migrated-db` with the default configuration.

#### `API-SPEC-01` — the document is served as OpenAPI 3.1 JSON
- given: (default)
- when: GET /openapi.json
- then:
  - status 200
  - header `Content-Type` is `application/json`
  - the body parses as a JSON object whose `openapi` is `"3.1.0"`
  - header `X-Request-Id` is a lowercase hyphenated UUID v4

#### `API-SPEC-02` — the document is titled "Task API" and carries the crate version
- given: (default)
- when: GET /openapi.json
- then:
  - `info.title` is `"Task API"`
  - `info.version` equals `<version>`

#### `API-SPEC-03` — the document passes the OpenAPI 3.1 validator
- given: (default)
- when: GET /openapi.json
- then:
  - the body validates against `tests/fixtures/openapi-3.1-schema.json` (JSON Schema draft 2020-12) with zero errors
  - every `$ref` value in the body has the form `#/components/schemas/<name>`, and `<name>` is a key of `components.schemas`

#### `API-SPEC-04` — the documentation routes are not documented
- given: (default)
- when: GET /openapi.json
- then:
  - no key of `paths` equals `/openapi.json`
  - no key of `paths` starts with `/docs`
  - no key of `paths` starts with `/__test`

#### `API-SPEC-05` — enabling test routes does not change the document
- given: the service runs against `migrated-db` with `ENABLE_TEST_ROUTES=true`
- when: GET /openapi.json
- then:
  - the keys of `paths` are exactly `/health`, `/tasks` and `/tasks/{id}`
  - the body is byte-identical to the body the same revision serves with `ENABLE_TEST_ROUTES` unset

#### `API-SPEC-06` — no fixed server address is declared
- given: (default)
- when: GET /openapi.json
- then:
  - `servers` is absent, or every entry of `servers` has `url` equal to `/`

#### `API-SPEC-07` — other methods are rejected
- given: (default)
- when: POST /openapi.json with `Content-Type: application/json` and body `{}`
- then:
  - status 405
  - body is exactly `{"error":{"code":"method_not_allowed","message":"Method not allowed","details":[]}}`

### Swagger UI

**Common given:** the service is running against `migrated-db` with the default configuration.

#### `API-DOCS-01` — /docs answers 200 HTML directly
- given: (default)
- when: GET /docs
- then:
  - status 200
  - the response has no `Location` header
  - header `Content-Type` starts with `text/html`
  - the body contains an element with `id="swagger-ui"`
  - header `X-Request-Id` is a lowercase hyphenated UUID v4

#### `API-DOCS-02` — the UI loads /openapi.json with Try it out enabled
- given: (default)
- when: GET /docs/swagger-initializer.js
- then:
  - status 200
  - header `Content-Type` is a JavaScript media type (`application/javascript` or `text/javascript`, optionally with a charset)
  - the Swagger UI configuration embedded in the body sets `url` to `"/openapi.json"`
  - the same configuration sets `tryItOutEnabled` to `true`

#### `API-DOCS-03` — every asset referenced by /docs is served under /docs/
- given: (default), and `docs-html` is the body of GET /docs
- when: GET every stylesheet `href` and script `src` in `docs-html`, each resolved against the URL `/docs` and the document's `<base>` element when present
- then:
  - every resolved URL's path starts with `/docs/`
  - every response has status 200
  - each `Content-Type` matches its kind: `text/css` for stylesheets, a JavaScript media type for scripts
  - the resolved script URLs include `/docs/swagger-initializer.js`

#### `API-DOCS-04` — the trailing-slash form serves the same page
- given: (default)
- when: GET /docs/
- then:
  - status 200
  - header `Content-Type` starts with `text/html`
  - the body is byte-identical to the body of GET /docs

#### `API-DOCS-05` — an unknown file under /docs/ is the uniform 404
- given: (default)
- when: GET /docs/does-not-exist.js
- then:
  - status 404
  - body is exactly `{"error":{"code":"not_found","message":"Route not found","details":[]}}`

#### `API-DOCS-06` — other methods on /docs are rejected
- given: (default)
- when: POST /docs with `Content-Type: application/json` and body `{}`
- then:
  - status 405
  - body is exactly `{"error":{"code":"method_not_allowed","message":"Method not allowed","details":[]}}`

### Spec Conformance

## Build
